reading.title: Scorpio Ingress and Void Pisces Moon
overview: The Sun at 0° Scorpio conjoins Venus while Mercury stations retrograde at 21° Scorpio. The Moon at 29° Pisces remains void of course until 20:00 UTC before entering Aries, forming a conjunction with Neptune at 2° Aries.

Mundane tradition reads the Scorpio Sun-Venus conjunction and Mercury station as periods of intensified scrutiny over shared resources and communications. Neptune sextile Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto continue slow societal shifts already in motion, while Venus square Pluto and Sun square Pluto highlight tensions around values and power.

Mars at 14° Leo trine Saturn at 10° Aries retrograde suggests attrition and constrained action. The last New Moon at 17° Libra falls in the 11th house for the United States and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC and squares natal Venus while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reporting on shifting US engagement with Ukraine but show no stronger link than other periods.

Transiting Neptune squares natal Sun and Mars conjoins the ascendant. Uranus trines natal Saturn. The New Moon in the 6th house places emphasis on armed forces and public health without recorded deviation from baseline activity.

Transiting Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it. The New Moon in the 6th house and Mars in the 4th align with ongoing air-raid reporting, though records show no predictive gain over chance.
Transiting Pluto opposes natal Moon and Jupiter sextiles the ascendant. The New Moon in the 6th house places focus on security matters without measurable departure from expected alert levels.

reading.lore_and_intel: Mercury square Jupiter and Sun square Pluto overlap with reporting on a proposed Oleshky ceasefire and related diplomacy at z-scores above 4.0. Venus square Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto touch drone and nuclear-waste stories at similar elevations. Neptune opposition US MC and several Mars aspects show no corresponding elevation in the listed intelligence items.
reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, retrogrades, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid counts, Israeli alerts, Russian losses and global magnitude-6+ earthquakes. All tested correlations fall within expected random variation after correction.
